hints.title: Medal Hierarchy Sort
hints.text: Sort participating countries primarily by gold medals descending.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Criteria
hints.text: Break ties using silver medals descending, followed by bronze medals descending.

hints.title: Alphabetical Final Tie Breaker
hints.text: If all medal counts match, order alphabetically by country name in ascending order.

hints.title: Multi-Column Order Query Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
select
    country,
    gold_medals,
    silver_medals,
    bronze_medals
from Olympic
order by gold_medals desc, silver_medals desc, bronze_medals desc, country asc;
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting manually without composite SQL order by produces incorrect ranks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrates multi-key ordering rules with descending and ascending flags.
